title: Agnes divides the farm (paraphrase D)
topic: A notary settles an inheritance dispute: Agnes keeps a farmer's will, the son demands the whole farm, the daughter cites the statute that grants each child half, the son's appeal fails, Agnes summons both heirs to a final meeting
tail_E: The settlement is drawn up, and Agnes hands both heirs a pen to
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'sign' is the natural continuation of 'Agnes hands both heirs a pen to' once the notary's settlement of the inheritance is drawn up; the word and its German equivalents (unterschreiben / unterzeichnen / Unterschrift) occur nowhere in the units or the tail, and no word containing 'sign' is used. author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F18 (inheritance dispute, notary Agnes)
notes: Formulation D, domain law: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F18A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Agnes). Replacements include works as a notary/has a notary's office (arbeitet als Notarin/hat ein Notariat), an old farmer's will lies in her safe/an old farmer's testament rests in her safe (Bauer, liegt, Tresor/Landwirt, ruht, Tresor), his two children claim the farm after his death/his two heirs contest the farm after his passing (beanspruchen/streiten um, Tod/Ableben), reads the will aloud in her office/announces the will in her chambers (verliest/verkündet, Büro/Amtsräume), demands the whole farm/insists on the entire farm (fordert/pocht auf), cites the law in a calm voice/mentions the statute in a steady voice (zitiert/erwähnt, ruhig/fest), grants each child half in such cases/secures each child half in such matters (gewährt/sichert, in solchen Fällen/in solchen Angelegenheiten), lodges an appeal with the regional court/seeks a ruling from the regional court (geht in Berufung/verlangt ein Urteil), the court dismisses the appeal/upholds the will (verwirft die Berufung/bestätigt das Testament), summons both heirs to a final meeting/gathers both heirs for one last meeting (bestellt/versammelt). 'verkündet', 'erwähnt', 'verlangt', 'bestätigt' and 'versammelt' are inseparable, 'pocht auf' and 'streiten um' take prepositional objects; no separable verbs ('vorlesen', 'bekanntgeben', 'zusprechen', 'anfechten', 'abweisen', 'zusammenrufen' avoided). Unit 2 has a bare intransitive predicate as in F18A/B. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
